required_conventions.body_anchors: Physical grounding in every scene (hands, eyes, breath, spine, jaw, feet)
required_conventions.sensory_details: At least 2 senses per scene (touch, sound, smell, taste, sight)
required_conventions.subtext: Characters never name their emotional states directly
required_conventions.silence: What characters DON'T say is as important as what they do

prohibited_patterns.camera_directions: No 'we see,' 'the camera,' 'close on,' CUT TO, ANGLE ON, etc.
prohibited_patterns.invisible_information: No durations, off-screen knowledge, historical interiority
